name: Kyosha Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyosha Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells printed wiring boards (PWBs), and carrier jigs for mounting electrical components in Japan, China, East and Southeast Asia, North America, and Mexico. It offers dustless construction method Kyosha-Max; and PWB designing services. The company also provides MagiCarrier, a carrier jig for printed boards and micro-components; MagiCarrier- ß, a double-sided adhesive sheet that has high heat resistance; MagiCarrier-DIP, a carrier for flow soldering; and MagiFix, a holding jig for printed boards during solder printing and mounting. In addition, it offers metal mask, a jig that is used when printing solder paste on printed boards; laser metal mask for high-precision mounting; COB mask for uneven PWB surfaces; and PH mask for uneven surfaces of FPC and ceramic boards. The company was formerly known as Kyoto Shashingata Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kyosha Co., Ltd. in November 1982. Kyosha Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
